test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

Some books are novels.

All novels are stories.

**Conclusions: **

(I): Some stories are books.

(II): No books are stories.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68a24c83ca04f2e9ebb911a77f1a46d62543bad431625afc5f88605c4409f227.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5dcce010838fda18701f7363e6a72ed6544f20cc0d8b74ddc638fd6890cd5a3.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some stories are books → Follow (As some books are novels and all novels are stories. As some part books is common with novels which whole comes in stories, therefore it is true.)

(II) No books are stories → Does not follow (As some books are novels and all novels are stories. As no direct relation is given between books and stories, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
